description: How often have playlists been explored? Counts from the GoldSeam Playlist store: policies and playlists by status, explorations with hits and first runs, the most-explored playlists, one playlist's line tallies, reviews and run shares. Small counts are shown as fewer than 5. Explorations are runs, not people. Also, by built_by, for policies and for playlists: saves, first-try passes, average attempts to pass, and reviews passed or rejected.

checklist_id.description: Optional: one checklist, by its checklist_id from a CourseShelf answer; adds that checklist's playlist lines with their tallies

since.description: Optional: count only what was recorded on or after this UTC date, YYYY-MM-DD

unitid.description: Optional: one school, by its IPEDS UNITID

name: playlist_summary
title: Playlist Summary
